card.line: Laish was a quiet, faraway city in the north that the tribe of Dan attacked and burned, then rebuilt and renamed Dan.

moments.title: Spies see a peaceful city
moments.text: Five men from Dan came to Laish and saw people living securely, quiet and unsuspecting. The land lacked nothing, and the city had no strong ruler and no allies.

moments.title: Spies speak of Micah's idols
moments.text: The five men who had spied out Laish told their brothers about the ephod, household gods, and idols in Micah's house. The Danites then took these things and the priest on their way to Laish.

moments.title: Dan attacks Laish
moments.text: The Danites took Micah's idols and his priest and went to Laish. They struck the quiet, unsuspecting people with swords and burned the city. No one was there to rescue them.

moments.title: Laish becomes Dan
moments.text: The Danites rebuilt the city and lived there. They named it Dan, after their forefather Dan, son of Israel, and set up Micah's graven image there.
